text:
Marta: Quick sync request 1 — need to lock down form validation patterns for Console before I update the comps: inline errors vs top summary, required markers for SRs, and policy on destructive confirms. I have 3 lightweight options sketched. James: Are we deciding for tiny modals (e.g., delete snapshot) or big multi-section forms? feels like different UX. Marta: Both. Goal: accessible, low-friction, no noisy duplication. My lean: inline errors + compact summary for big forms. Sam: A11y checklist if we go inline+summary: - On submit, focus moves to first invalid field or to error summary for form-level failures - Each invalid control has aria-describedby -> error id - Provide a focusable summary at top with role/aria-live so SRs get context James: Implementation snippet for summary (works well): ```
We found 2 problems. See fields highlighted below.
``` and call document.getElementById('error-summary').focus() on failure. Sam: Note: aria-live polite isn't a substitute for moving focus. Move focus for reliable announcement. Olivia: Required fields copy: show asterisk visually but how should SRs be told? label text, aria-required, or sr-only? Marta: Proposal: visual asterisk + sr-only "required" in the label. Example: Sam: Good. Also add aria-required="true" on the input for form tooling parity. James: Validation timing: validate on submit by default. Validate on blur only for deterministic rules (email format, repo name pattern). Marta: Agreed 1. Avoid inline errors while typing unless field-level check is immediate. Olivia: Destructive confirms: two main patterns — checkbox "I understand..." vs typed confirm (enter resource name). Typed confirm is safest but higher friction. Thoughts? Sam: Risk-based rule: - Typed confirm for irreversible, high-impact deletes (clusters, prod models) - Checkbox for lower-risk deletes (single job cancellation) Also ensure typed-confirm modals disable keyboard shortcuts and require an explicit click. James: Dev note: for typed confirm, prevent submit via Enter/Cmd+Enter. Force click to avoid accidental keyboard shortcuts. Marta: Decision proposal to merge into design tokens and comps: - Inline errors appear after submit; validate-on-blur only for deterministic fields - Add compact, focusable error summary for multi-field forms (focus it when submit yields >0 errors) - Required marking: visible asterisk + sr-only "required"; set aria-required on inputs when applicable - Destructive: typed-confirm for irreversible resources; checkbox for mid-risk; disable keyboard shortcuts for typed-confirm Olivia: Microcopy guideline: always include the resource id and consequence. Example: "Type 'redwood-inference-2026' to permanently delete this model. This cannot be undone." Keep voice firm. Sam: I'll do a quick screen-reader pass on the updated comp once posted. Checklist: focus order, aria-describedby links, role/aria-live behavior. James: I'll prototype the focus+aria wiring in sandbox and open a small PR. Marta: I'll update comps and include code examples + edge-case states (summary, sr-only labels, typed-confirm). Targeting EOD Wednesday for first pass. aria-bot: UX ticket created 1 UX-2312 "Form validation patterns & destructive confirm policy" assigned to Marta, due in 3 days.
